title: AILA Daily Briefing
description: Rolling daily briefing fetched by the AILA app. English is canonical. German lives under i18n.de. At most 7 days, newest first, with 6 to 8 items each day.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time with a numeric offset, for example 2026-10-08T04:45:00+02:00. A trailing Z is not an offset here.

days.description: Newest Europe/Berlin calendar day first. Drop the oldest day when a new one would make eight.

id.description: Unique across the file. The date prefix equals the day's date.

headline.description: Sentence case. At most 60 characters. Glossary terms stay lowercase common nouns.

summary.description: One or two sentences. At most 240 characters.

source.description: Exactly one source: the publisher name and a single https URL.

name.description: Publisher name, for example TechCrunch or Anthropic.

url.description: Well-formed https URL of that publication. Same pattern as pulse.schema.json.

tag.description: Same tag list as the daily pulse. The reference keeps the two schemas in sync.

priority.description: Optional. breaking marks a major launch the app may pin. Omit it, or use normal, for a routine item.

pulseId.description: Optional id of a related pulse.json item. A well-formed id that is not in the current pulse.json is a warning; the app hides the deep-dive link. A malformed id is an error.

level.description: Optional. Missing means beginner-friendly. Use advanced only when the item needs real jargon.

summary.description: German prose. Technical AI terms stay in English.
